fusions.name: Drifting Shove
fusions.desc: Sends a slow wave into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. Anything struck moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Swell Push
fusions.desc: Pushes a wide cone of water ahead of you, dealing 14 damage to everything caught in it and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Slow Bulwark
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 12 seconds, and raises your armour by 6%.

fusions.name: Unhurried Mass
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14. You also regenerate 0.8 health a second, permanently.
